ADDITIONAL SKILLS

Expert at prompt engineering and artificial intelligence


Chang Yun Shiang (Edison)

Singapore Rangoon road 99

08/12/2023

Mr. Serene Yeo

HR Director

Ensign InfoSecurity

30A Kallang Pl

Singapore 339213

Dear sir,

I am writing in response to the job position of Cybersecurity Threat Analyst.

Ensign InfoSecurity caught my attention in the first place because of your highly advanced cybersecurity solutions that are ahead of the curve like machine learning driven algorithms for detecting malware. I think I am suitable for this position because I have a genuine passion for technology, and I want to discover more in the future.

Furthermore, I believe that my academic qualifications Bachelor of Information Technology in Cyber Security and Forensics and additional certificate of master in artificial intelligence prompt engineering meet the eligibility requirement of this position.

I am dedicated in this job with the knowledge and lessons from the past job positions, with numerous penetration ethical hacking tests conducted by me before, I believe the learning curve of this position would be no where near steep. During the last 13 years of my work experience, my success of onion routing protocol in anonymizing the online traffic across the encrypted network protected my company from leaking confidential information and classified data would be a great testament to qualification of this position.

Thank you for your time and consideration, I welcome the chance to have a discussion with you in further detail if you would like to call me in for an interview.

You can contact me on email ( yunxiangzhang350@gmail.com). I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Yours sincerely,

Chang Yun Shiang
